clause.title: Only pending orders may be cancelled
clause.text: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.

clause.title: Confirm order ID and an allowed cancellation reason
clause.text: The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation. Other reasons are not acceptable.

clause.title: Cancellation status and refund timing
clause.text: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled', and the total will be refunded via the original payment method immediately if it is gift card, otherwise in 5 to 7 business days.

clause.title: Present details and obtain explicit confirmation
clause.text: Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.

clause.title: Do not invent information or procedures
clause.text: You should not make up any information or knowledge or procedures not provided by the user or the tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.

clause.title: Authenticate before account assistance
clause.text: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.

checks.description: The user was authenticated through an allowed lookup.
The action details were presented before the write action.
The user explicitly confirmed the write action.
The order status is pending.
The user confirmed the order ID.
The cancellation reason is allowed by policy.

conclusion.statement: All cited requirements passed; the action is eligible for planning.

clause.title: Only delivered orders may be returned
clause.text: An order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action.

clause.title: Confirm the return order and item list
clause.text: The user needs to confirm the order id and the list of items to be returned.

clause.title: Return request outcome
clause.text: After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'return requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items.

clause.title: Return refund method restrictions
clause.text:
The user needs to provide a payment method to receive the refund.

The refund must either go to the original payment method, or an existing gift card.
